parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name. <props="china">You can call [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains) to obtain the domain name.</props>
<props="intl">You can call [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the domain name.</props>

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description:
The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
><warning>If the query time range is large and the domain name has a high volume of resolution logs, the query may time out or return inaccurate results.></warning>

parameters.name: ServerRegion
parameters.description: The region of the resolution cluster.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
